title: Shark Beauty and actor Kevin Hart co-design limited edition CryoGlow LED Mask
summary: Shark Beauty’s CryoGlow LED Mask lands in a new colourway co-designed by comedian and brand ambassador Kevin Hart, who is set to take part in the upcoming ‘Glow Like A Bro’ campaign
